name: premiums
description: Premium Collections Control Tower: premium due, overdue, unapplied cash, failed payment attempts and recovery actions for general insurers. A static SPA with typed contracts, a collections rules engine and an in-browser mock API over versioned synthetic fixtures.

scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings 0 src/contracts src/mock-api src/read-model src/rules scripts
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace @premiums/ui
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:ui && npm run typecheck:e2e && npm run lint && npm run lint:ui && npm test && npm run test:ui && npm run build
